name: CSG Distance Field Evaluation (Batched)
definition: A batched algorithm to compute signed distance values and material indices for a set of points against a Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) tree, supporting Union, Intersection, Difference, Translation, Rotation, Plane, Cylinder, Sphere, and Box primitives.
summary: This method computes signed distances and material indices for a batch of points against a CSG tree, enabling efficient parallel processing for ray marching.
